mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3pp decline in unemployment rate over 3 months signals labor market tightening, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where UNRATE falls >0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST > 900 thousand units and INDPRO rising above 3-month average signals synchronized housing demand and manufacturing supply expansion, boosting earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of triggered instances, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY combined with FEDFUNDS rising >0.25pp signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS growth exceeding 100,000 jobs/month consistently indicates robust labor market conditions, driving consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months with PAYEMS growth >100,000, or Rank IC < 0.03.
